black tongue coating.cn: 黑舌苔，舌面呈现深黑色苔层，质地厚重，多见于重症或邪热炽盛。
black tongue coating.en-us: Black tongue coating, deep black coating layer indicates severe illness or excessive pathogenic heat.
black tongue coating.ja: 黒舌苔、舌面に深黒色の苔層、重症または邪熱盛を示す。

map tongue coating.cn: 地图舌，舌苔剥落不全，呈地图状分布，反映胃阴不足或气血虚弱。
map tongue coating.en-us: Map tongue, patchy coating loss with map-like appearance, suggests stomach yin deficiency or qi-blood weakness.
map tongue coating.ja: 地図舌、苔の剥離が不完全で地図状分布、胃陰不足または気血虚弱を反映。

purple tongue coating.cn: 紫舌苔，舌质呈紫色，苔色深暗，多提示血瘀或寒凝血脉。
purple tongue coating.en-us: Purple tongue coating, purplish tongue with dark coating, indicates blood stasis or cold congealing blood vessels.
purple tongue coating.ja: 紫舌苔、紫色の舌質と暗色の苔、瘀血または寒凝血脈を示唆。

red tongue yellow fur thick greasy fur.cn: 红舌黄毛厚腻苔，舌质红赤，苔色黄厚且腻，提示湿热内蕴。
red tongue yellow fur thick greasy fur.en-us: Red tongue with yellow thick greasy coating, red tongue body with yellow thick coating suggests dampness-heat accumulation.
red tongue yellow fur thick greasy fur.ja: 赤舌黄毛厚膩苔、赤い舌質に黄色厚膩の苔、湿熱内蘊を示す。

The red tongue is thick and greasy.cn: 红舌厚腻苔，舌质红润，苔层厚腻，多见于脾胃湿热或痰湿内阻。
The red tongue is thick and greasy.en-us: Red tongue with thick greasy coating, red moist tongue with thick coating indicates spleen-stomach dampness-heat or phlegm-dampness obstruction.
The red tongue is thick and greasy.ja: 赤舌厚膩苔、赤潤な舌質に厚膩の苔、脾胃湿熱または痰湿内阻を示す。

The white tongue is thick and greasy.cn: 白舌厚腻苔，舌质偏淡，苔层白厚腻滑，多提示寒湿内盛或脾阳不足。
The white tongue is thick and greasy.en-us: White tongue with thick greasy coating, pale tongue with white thick slippery coating suggests cold-dampness excess or spleen yang deficiency.
The white tongue is thick and greasy.ja: 白舌厚膩苔、淡色の舌質に白厚膩滑な苔、寒湿内盛または脾陽不足を示す。
